name: @dhruvchoudhary/dsgn
description: CLI that copies dsgn design-system components into your project's own source tree — no runtime dependency on this package, in the shadcn/ui tradition. Works in any React + Tailwind project. Includes diff/update for tracking upstream changes, composed recipes, a doctor health-check, VS Code snippets, and a Claude Code Agent Skill installer (dsgn skill --global / --project).
author: Dhruv Choudhary
